nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the SessionCreator feature, including the UseSessionCreatorReturn shape and supporting ref/state/handler interfaces consumed across the session-creator hooks.

nodes.name: useAdvancedConfig.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that reads and updates per-org advanced session configuration (model/key selection), backed by Jotai atoms and account/key-vault lookups.

nodes.name: useDraftManagement.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that persists and restores the in-progress session draft (editor content, session name, uploaded files) with debounced auto-save and composer restoration.

nodes.name: useFileUpload.ts
nodes.summary: Thin re-export shim exposing the shared useFileUpload hook (and its options type) from the common hooks location for use within SessionCreator.

nodes.name: useMarketDeeplink.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that parses market-attribution deep-link query parameters on mount, applies the referenced model selection, and strips the params from the URL.

nodes.name: useSessionCreator.ts
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrating hook for the session creation UI that composes repo selection, advanced config, drafts, file/image uploads, validation, and launch into a single UseSessionCreatorReturn API.

nodes.name: errorUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Classifies raw launch error messages as auth (401) or balance (402) failures and formats a user-facing error string via known error-pattern matching.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook implementing the full session-launch flow: validates input, resolves API keys, guards against secrets, builds the launch payload, invokes the Rust launch backend, and handles navigation/error outcomes.

nodes.name: inputPreparation.ts
nodes.summary: Prepares the final launch input text by formatting composer pill content and appending fenced code blocks for any pending terminal-output pills.

nodes.name: launchErrorHandling.ts
nodes.summary: Extracts a readable message from a caught launch error and routes it to auth/balance-specific modal handlers or a generic error toast.

nodes.name: launchHelpers.ts
nodes.summary: Provides post-launch navigation logic that determines the view mode for the new session's route and updates workstation/session-selection state accordingly, plus a re-exported synthetic-event factory.

nodes.name: launchMode.ts
nodes.summary: Single-purpose predicate that determines whether a given session-creator launch mode is the background-start mode.

nodes.name: launchPayload.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the session-launch request payload (repo paths, additional directories, worktree/base-branch fields, agent identity) and converts a launch result into a Session object for the store.

nodes.name: launchValidation.tsx
nodes.summary: UI-facing validation helpers that surface validation errors via toast and confirm with the user before launching an unusually short prompt.

nodes.name: resolveKeys.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves the API key to use for launch, either validating a user-supplied own key or fetching/refreshing a hosted token, surfacing auth errors through callbacks.

nodes.name: syntheticEvents.ts
nodes.summary: Injects a synthetic user-message event into session state so the chat UI immediately reflects the just-launched prompt before the backend confirms.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the useSessionLaunch hook, including its options/return shapes and work-item/launch-success context interfaces.

nodes.name: useInputFormatter.ts
nodes.summary: Formats the composer's raw text and file pills into the final user-input string sent with a session launch, converting pills to @-relative-path references.

nodes.name: walletModalState.ts
nodes.summary: Small hook managing the open/closed state of the add-funds and buy-credits wallet modals shown on launch-time balance errors.

nodes.name: useSessionValidation.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that validates the current session-creator configuration (content, agent, provider/model selection, branch name) and returns a list of validation errors before launch is allowed.

nodes.name: useAdvancedConfig
nodes.summary: Reads the org-scoped advanced-config atom, resolves whether the selected key is hosted vs. self-owned, and returns update setters plus the last-used model pair.

nodes.name: useDraftManagement
nodes.summary: Loads the persisted session draft into editor/upload state on mount, auto-saves changes on a debounce, and clears/restores drafts around session switches.

nodes.name: useMarketDeeplink
nodes.summary: On mount, reads model/provider query params from a marketing deep link, applies the selection, and cleans the URL.

nodes.name: useSessionCreator
nodes.summary: Composes repo selection, advanced config, drafts, uploads, slash commands, validation and launch hooks into the full session-creator API consumed by the UI.

nodes.name: isAuthError
nodes.summary: Detects whether an error message indicates an authentication/401 failure via keyword and pattern matching.

nodes.name: isBalanceError
nodes.summary: Detects whether an error message indicates an insufficient-balance/402 failure via keyword and pattern matching.

nodes.name: formatAgentLaunchError
nodes.summary: Maps a raw agent-launch error message to a friendlier, pattern-matched display string.

nodes.name: useSessionLaunch
nodes.summary: Drives the end-to-end session launch: validation, secret scanning, key resolution, payload construction, backend invocation, optimistic UI updates, and error/navigation handling.

nodes.name: prepareLaunchInput
nodes.summary: Builds the final launch text by formatting the composer input and appending any pending terminal-pill output as fenced code blocks.

nodes.name: getErrorMessage
nodes.summary: Extracts a string message from an unknown thrown error value.

nodes.name: handleNonCursorLaunchError
nodes.summary: Handles a failed session launch by classifying the error and showing the appropriate auth/balance modal or a generic toast.

nodes.name: handleSessionNavigation
nodes.summary: Navigates to (or stays in place for) the newly launched session's route and updates active-session/workstation state.

nodes.name: isBackgroundLaunchMode
nodes.summary: Returns true when the given launch mode is the background-start mode.

nodes.name: getAdditionalDirectories
nodes.summary: Resolves which workspace folders should be sent as additional directories for the launch, matching the session's repo path against known workspace folders.

nodes.name: getRustAgentIdentityFields
nodes.summary: Derives the Rust-agent identity fields (agent type, provider, model) to include in the launch payload from the current options.

nodes.name: getWorktreeFields
nodes.summary: Derives worktree-related payload fields (base ref/branch) from the worktree launch source, when present.

nodes.name: buildSessionLaunchPayload
nodes.summary: Assembles the full backend launch request payload from session source, advanced config, key, worktree and identity fields.

nodes.name: buildSessionFromLaunchResult
nodes.summary: Converts a backend launch result into the client-side Session object used to populate the store after a successful launch.

nodes.name: showValidationErrors
nodes.summary: Displays a toast listing all current session-configuration validation errors.

nodes.name: confirmShortInputIfNeeded
nodes.summary: Prompts the user to confirm launching when the editor content is unusually short, to avoid accidental low-content sessions.

nodes.name: resolveOwnKey
nodes.summary: Validates that a user-supplied own API key is present in advanced config, surfacing an error toast if missing.

nodes.name: resolveHostedKey
nodes.summary: Fetches or refreshes the hosted API token for launch, invoking an auth-error callback on failure.

nodes.name: resolveKeys
nodes.summary: Dispatches to hosted or own-key resolution depending on the configured key source.

nodes.name: injectSyntheticUserEventIfNeeded
nodes.summary: Creates and dispatches a synthetic user-message event so the launched session's UI shows the prompt immediately.

nodes.name: formatUserInput
nodes.summary: Converts composer file pills into @-relative-path references and combines them with the trimmed editor text.

nodes.name: useWalletModalState
nodes.summary: Manages open/close state for the add-funds and buy-credits wallet modals.

nodes.name: useSessionValidation
nodes.summary: Validates the current session configuration (content, agent selection, provider/model, branch name) and returns a callback producing structured validation errors.
